subject: mb-3-cs-b15-app1-architecture
intent: Show the five-app system and every outside service with its credential home, so the reader trusts that client code never touches data or secrets and every cross-boundary call runs through one named seam. The load-bearing claim: a client instance holds only the schema, one startup module and its dependency - all logic and every credential path is server-side (design doc section 6 constraint 3; section 23.4).
type_reason: Components, boundaries and ownership; the default for everything that exists and connects; not a flow picture.

node_roles.client-browser: public client code; never holds credentials or rules
node_roles.app1: development workspace; never a dependency for any client
node_roles.app2: master_template - the published dependency; all server logic and forms
node_roles.app3: blank_client_template - the provisioning clone source; schema, startup, dependency
node_roles.app4: client instance - schema, startup module, dependency; nothing else
node_roles.app5: Mybizz management - registry, push notifications, AI gateway
node_roles.gateways: Stripe, Paystack, PayPal; card data never touches the instance
node_roles.ses: Amazon SES/SNS/S3 - every email received and sent
node_roles.r2: the client's own R2 bucket - cold data and backups
node_roles.groq: AI and speech - reached only through App 5
